evidence.claim: Flagged transaction T3581141 was executed on a new device ('0f3463829514') flagged as 'Found' by device tracking.
The transaction utilized an online product code ('S') and a gmail.com email domain.
Customer C08299 explicitly stated via message: 'I never made this $30.02 purchase.'

case.summary: Customer C08299 contacted the bank to report an unrecognized online purchase of $30.02 (transaction T3581141) made on December 28, 2016. The flagged transaction occurred on a new device key ('0f3463829514') using an online channel (product code S) with a Gmail email domain. Given the direct customer report disputing the charge and the presence of a new device, the transaction is verified as fraudulent.
